title: Integer-weighted series estimate in [0, ∞]: summability and |Σ c_r a_r| ≤ C·Σ|c_r| m_r
statement: Let a : ℕ → ℝ, c : ℕ → ℤ, m : ℕ → [0, ∞] and C ∈ ℝ. Write |c_r| := ((c_r).natAbs : [0, ∞]). Assume ENNReal.ofReal|a_r| ≤ m_r·ENNReal.ofReal C for every r ∈ ℕ, and Σ'_r |c_r|·m_r < ∞ in [0, ∞]. Then r ↦ c_r·a_r (with c_r cast to ℝ) is summable in ℝ, and ENNReal.ofReal|Σ'_r c_r·a_r| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C·Σ'_r |c_r|·m_r.
lean_statement: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (c : ℕ → ℤ) (m : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) (C : ℝ), (∀ r, ENNReal.ofReal |a r| ≤ m r * ENNReal.ofReal C) → (∑' r, ((c r).natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) * m r) < ∞ → Summable (fun r => (c r : ℝ) * a r) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal |∑' r, (c r : ℝ) * a r| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C * ∑' r, ((c r).natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) * m r
